builders.bio: Sr Director, AI at Meta; Prev: Google - Led Gemini, Veo, Nano Banana.

tweets.text:
There are massive startup opportunities hiding in plain sight : every layer of the computing stack will need to be rebuilt for agents.

For the last few years, most of the focus has been on making enterprise software agent-ready: APIs, connectors, MCPs.

Now personal agents are forcing the same conversation for consumer products - e-commerce is an early example.

This is just the tip of the iceberg.

Now think about the rest of the stack:

Desktop and mobile OSes where agents are first-class users

Cloud infra built for agents to operate directly.

identity, permissions and security designed for thousands of agents acting on our behalf.

Interfaces designed for agent and human users or both working together.

If you’re looking for startup ideas, go through each layer of the computing stack and ask: what has to change when the primary user is an agent?

tweets.text: We built Box Mount to allow developers to mount Box as a file system directly in any agent sandbox. As agents do more complex work, they need to be able to work with files and data just like a person would. The future is headless. https://t.co/hGBx3Tv4NL

The compute needed for the stage of AI we’re about to enter is going to be insane. 

Personal agents, agent swarms defending enterprises, agents that review all of our code for security issues, agents that process nearly all enterprise data in workflows, background agents working on tasks 24/7, and on and on. 

This will take a mix of inference volume that is going to keep growing by orders of magnitude, as well as infrastructure that agents need alongside the tokens. They need computers, networking, file systems, and so on.

We’re only in the early stages of what this buildout is going to look like.

连长期看空 BTC 的宏观 AI 研究机构，都开始反手建仓加密篮子了。

几个小时前，知名宏观与 AI 主题研究机构 @citrini  Research 发布了一篇长文《Breaking The Wall》，并破天荒地推出了他们有史以来的第一个加密代币投资组合。

给不了解这个机构的兄弟科普一下，Citrini Research 凭借过去两年对 AI 硬件、半导体供应链的精准主题投资名声大噪。

但他们长期认为，加密行业过去十年更像是一个“手里拿着锤子、到处找钉子”的行业，除了 Meme 赌博和稳定币转账，与华尔街传统金融完全是两个割裂的平行宇宙。

在其公开交易记录中，Citrini 曾在 2025 年底建立过“做多纳斯达克、做空比特币”的对冲头寸，直言很多代币缺乏基本面和真实现金流支撑。

那究竟是什么让这样一家专注于 AI 与宏观的传统投研机构，在今天选择打破次元壁呢？

文章作者认为，加密处在了 Agentic AI（自主智能体）与 RWA 的交汇点。

作者自己充了 1000 美元到 Coinbase Wallet，亲自下到链上战壕体验了一圈。

他发现，在科技圈还在为 GPU 算力瓶颈争吵不休时，链上已经悄悄建好了一套极像传统金融的基础设施，代币化国债、股票、期权、借贷与可编程债务一应俱全。

所以体验完了加密后，这家机构公开的加密投资组合，有极其鲜明的 “DeFi 基础设施 + 真实收入 + 衍生品” 取向：

Derive (DRV 10%)、Lighter (LIT 10%)、https://t.co/dIFwt1yhuL (ETHFI 10%)、Aave (AAVE 9%)、Ethena (ENA 9%)、Solana (SOL 8%)。

几乎清一色偏向能够产生协议真实费用、具有代币化资产承载力、或者为链上金融提供核心流动性的底层引擎。

与此同时，他们还在美股市场同步配齐了 Securitize、Circle、Coinbase、Robinhood 以及 Bitwise Hyperliquid ETF 等合规代理敞口。

推荐阅读《对话 Hyperliquid 创始人 Jeff：再让我创业一次，我会选择期权，Hyperliquid 的终局是承载所有金融活动》

CoinDesk 报道 Cointelegraph 要卖，Cointelegraph 公开否认辟谣

10 月 7 日晚，CoinDesk @CoinDesk 报道了一篇标题是流量大跌后 Cointelegraph @Cointelegraph  在找买家的文章。消息来自一位不愿具名的知情人士，要价没写。文中还称，在2025 年 10 月 Google 的一次人工处罚后，Cointelegraph的自然搜索流量掉了约 80%。

今早 Cointelegraph 官方账号直接 @CoinDesk 的出版人和编辑管理层。第一句话就是 We are not for sale。

Cointelegraph 表示，愿意接受监督，但不会对「将猜测呈现为事实」的做法保持沉默，并质疑 CoinDesk 是否通过制造争议吸引读者、推广活动或应对商业压力。

Cointelegraph 要求 CoinDesk 及其出版方和编辑管理层纠正相关报道，明确承认错误，并给予更正内容与原始报道同等的曝光度，而不是悄然修改措辞后继续维持原报道的可信度。Cointelegraph 同时强调，媒体公信力应建立在准确性和问责之上，而非依靠耸动标题获取关注。
